title: Apartment window cleaning
passage:
RIVERVIEW COURT | Notice to residents

The window cleaning crew will work outside the building on Monday and Tuesday. They can reach most windows from the courtyard. If your window opens onto a private balcony, however, the crew can clean that side only if you sign up for a balcony visit.

You don't have to be home for a courtyard window. Please close it by eight in the morning. For a balcony visit, someone from your household must be present to open the balcony door. We can't use a spare key left at the office.

The signup sheet has a box marked “both.” This means you can be home on either day, not that you need two visits. We will send you one time by text on Sunday evening. If you cannot make that time, tell the office before the crew arrives. We will keep your name for the next cleaning round; we cannot move the crew to another balcony on short notice because a resident may not be there.

河景公寓｜住戶通知

清潔人員將在星期一與星期二從大樓外側清洗窗戶。大部分窗戶都能從中庭清潔。不過，若窗戶朝向私人陽台，住戶必須登記陽台清潔，工作人員才能清洗那一側。

中庭窗戶清潔時，你不必在家，但請在早上八點前關窗。若已登記清潔陽台側窗戶，家中須有人在場開啟陽台門。我們不能使用留在辦公室的備用鑰匙。

登記表上有一欄寫著「兩天皆可」，表示你任一天都能在家，不是需要清洗兩次。我們會在星期日晚上用簡訊通知一個時段。若無法配合，請在清潔人員到達前通知辦公室。我們會保留你的名字，列入下一輪清潔；因為其他住戶可能不在家，我們不能臨時改去另一戶的陽台。
